name: Codename: TYPHOON
source:
[i][b]Moscow, USSR, 2017.[/b][/i]

When the Cold War flashed hot at the end of 1953, the United States nuked China and Korea, and the Soviet Union took New York City off the map. But now, even after the psychic revolution of the 1980s, the imperial fortunes of the great powers are waning, and the Cold War is running cold indeed.

The USSR, hoping to regain some of its long-lost glory, plans a May Day celebration commemorating one-hundred years of Soviet communism. But the US has its own plans...

Agent Angelica Gropius Rhythmic Triad Typhoon is a psychic secret agent, working for the CIA’s secretive spirituality division, codename: The Goatmen. Her mission is to smuggle a nuclear weapon into Moscow and detonate it at the height of celebrations, killing all the Kremlin’s top brass in one fell swoop.

However, Agent Typhoon is captured in the course of her mission, and brought to a KGB black site. There, she faces an unexpected enemy: a turncoat Goatmen agent, and her own mentor.

Now going by the name of Psycho Soldier Number Seven, she seeks to defeat her former student with her psychic powers.

Four hours until the bomb goes off. Can Agent Typhoon make it out?

[From [url=https://gravity-house.itch.io/codename-typhoon]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[i][b]2017年，苏联莫斯科。[/b][/i]

1953年底，冷战骤然烧成了热战。美国对中国和朝鲜发动核打击，苏联则把纽约市从地图上抹去。即使经历了20世纪80年代的灵能革命，各大国的帝国气数如今也在衰退，冷战这回当真冷了下来。

苏联企图重拾一部分失落已久的荣光，打算在五一节举行庆典，纪念苏维埃共产主义一百周年。美国却另有打算…

安杰莉卡·格罗皮乌斯·律动三重奏·台风是一名灵能特工，效力于美国中央情报局麾下一个代号“山羊人”的秘密灵异部门。她的任务是将一枚核武器偷运进莫斯科，在庆典最热烈的时刻引爆，一举消灭克里姆林宫的全部高层。

然而，台风特工在执行任务途中被俘，被带到了克格勃的一处秘密拘押点。在那里，她遇到了意料之外的敌人：一名叛变的山羊人特工，也是她自己的导师。

如今这位导师自称“七号灵能战士”，意欲以灵能击败往日的学生。

离炸弹爆炸还剩四小时。台风特工能逃出去吗？
